dedupe_keys.name: crowdegress agent based crowd evacuation simulator compatible with fds evac inputs

description: CrowdEgress is an open-source simulation platform for crowd behaviour in social context, extending the social force model to describe how agents interact with one another and with walls, doors and exits. It can read FDS+Evac input to build single-floor compartment geometry, and a flow solver computes the exit flow field used as a roadmap towards exits, an approach the README says was learned from FDS+Evac; the authors plan to add social and psychological theory such as pre-evacuation behaviour, exit selection, social groups and herding. Coverage: generic building compartments. Access: Python code on GitHub, originally Python 2.7 and adapted for Python 3, with Pygame, NumPy and an experimental Tkinter interface in version 2.3. Licence: Apache 2.0. Caveats: single-floor geometry only, research-grade code, and behavioural extensions are still planned. Simulation uses: fire and emergency evacuation of buildings and venues, testing exit layouts and pre-evacuation delay assumptions. Related records: the NIST Fire Dynamics Simulator, Pathfinder and the Vadere crowd simulator.
